The '''Neshei system''' was located in the [[Neshei sector/Legends|Neshei sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region of<ref name="Outer" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Dorin system/Legends|Dorin]] and [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss systems]]. The Neshei system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neshei system was established in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the system in grid square J-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
